replies.author: hpux
replies.body:
Hello,

Web Bans must be appealed separately from regular bans if they're for another reason. Furthermore, players must send in an appeal by themselves in order for the appeal to be considered.

Best regards,

Peacheh, Avicus Network Administrator.
